problem_statement:
feat(todo): model-driven task breakdown, rendered live in the TUI

New update_todos tool (mirrors Claude Code's own TodoWrite): the
model declares/updates its own subtask list for the current task,
rendered as a new section in the info panel -- complements the
existing pipeline breadcrumb, which shows structural graph position
(which fixed node is running) but nothing about what the coder
actually decided to do inside a long task.

State lives in control.RunControl (set_todos/todos), the same shared
channel the TUI already polls for activity/progress/stages -- no new
plumbing between the executor thread and the UI thread. Cleared on
every CONTROL.reset() (a todo list belongs to one task).

Exactly one item may be "in_progress" at a time (mirrors Claude
Code's own constraint) so the panel always has an unambiguous single
point of progress to highlight (yellow ▶), with completed items shown
struck through and pending ones dim. Read-only (no workspace
mutation, purely in-memory display state) so it's available to
read-only investigations too, same as web_search/fetch_url.

Verified end-to-end: tool dispatch, CONTROL round-trip, and the
actual InfoPanel._build() render path via a real mounted Textual app
(not just the underlying data, the literal Rich markup the panel
would show).
